Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing telephonic hearings in civil cases and traffic cases.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to telephonic hearings in civil cases and trafficcases; and adding new sections to chapter 3.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to promoteuniformity in the procedures and practices related to telephonichearings in civil cases and traffic cases in the courts of limitedjurisdiction. In order to improve access to the courts and reducelitigation costs, the courts of limited jurisdiction shall permittelephonic hearings at appropriate proceedings in civil cases andtraffic cases.

(1) Except as provided in subsection (2) ofthis section, in all civil cases and traffic cases, a party that hasprovided notice to the court may participate by telephone in lieu ofpersonal appearance in the following proceedings: All motions exceptmotions in limine; trial assignments; show cause proceedings; statusconferences; compliance and review hearings; and any other proceeding,if the court determines that participation by telephone is appropriate. p. 1 SB 5970 (2) The court may require a party to appear in person at aproceeding listed in subsection (1) of this section if the court findsthat a personal appearance would materially assist in the determinationof the proceeding or in the effective management or resolution of acase.

The administrator for the courts shalldevelop rules to implement section 2 of this act by December 30, 2009.The rules shall include, but are not limited to, the notice to be givenby a party requesting to participate in a proceeding by telephone; themanner in which a proceeding by telephone is to be conducted; theconditions required for a party to be permitted to participate in aproceeding by telephone; and the use by the courts of private vendorsto provide telephone services.
Sections 1 through 3 of this act are eachadded to chapter 3.02 RCW.
